# Genuine V0.4 fixture provenance

`v0.4-chapter.json` is the unchanged schema 7 / balance 0.4.0 save from
`test-results/v04-review-fixes-browser/outposts-B01-11-complete-t-1bc4e-ng-and-reopening-on-desktop/desktop-v04-save.json`.
Only its final newline is normalized. It is not a relabeled newer save.

`v0.4-offline-reference.json` records 86,400,517 milliseconds of advancement
and its return report using the genuine V0.4 working-tree engine on 2026-10-23,
before any V0.5 source edits. The engine decoded the source save, called
`advance` and `summarize`, and passed its original `assertInvariants`.
The reference contains the original fixture SHA-256 and SHA-256 hashes of
every `src/game/*.ts` file used. HEAD `d2dca809df0694718079830dbd3c99e060eb2ff3`
is the previous V0.3.3 revision, not the source of this V0.4 engine.

Migration tests compare retained V0.4 fields, excluding only the additive
empty calendar model and newly available unconfirmed L05 story. No V0.5
simulation was used to generate this expected state or report.
